claim: Household robots emerge before full acceptance
originalWording: Household robots emerge before full acceptance

sources.title: Spiritual Machines: The Merging of Man and Machine — Ray Kurzweil

sourceCaveat: The original book edition has not been independently checked. See the listed source and full record for attribution limits.

reference.criterion: Useful household robots are commercially established but not yet universally accepted.
reference.rationale: Roomba launched in 2002 and iRobot reported five million home robots sold just after the 2009 year-end; this confirms a substantial pre-deadline product category. The existence/emergence claim was met. Later broader adoption does not retroactively invalidate the accurate early-stage description.

evidence.title: iRobot: More than five million home robots sold
evidence.note: January 2010 retrospective on robots launched in 2002 and already commercially established in the 2000s; do not shift the threshold by one year just because the tally was announced in January..
